subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion - Recap and Next Steps
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acme.com>
Date: 2026-04-22 09:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — thanks for the call

Marissa — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our side so we're aligned on next steps: 

- Current situation: ACME's Q1 / Q2 usage has increased ~3x due to seasonal promos. We're seeing big latency spikes during peak hours (50–70% higher than baseline) and token costs are ramping.
- Primary pain points: latency at 95th percentile, unpredictable costs on hosted endpoints, and concerns around PII in some user flows (we need stronger isolation).
- Goals: stabilize latency to under 300ms p95 for core flows, get predictable pricing for forecasted growth, evaluate Dedicated or Private deployment for sensitive workloads.
- Proposed expansion: move the recommendation engine workload (~200 RPS peak, 1.2M tokens/day) to a Dedicated pool; keep chat/assist on hosted for now.

Action items we discussed:
1) Redwood to provide a high-level pricing estimate for Dedicated (monthly) and an ops runbook for migration.
2) Redwood SE to confirm latency targets and suggested instance profiles for our workload.
3) Procurement to get SOW and MOU language for approvals.

Attaching the usage export we pulled from our side. Let me know if you want raw logs.

Attachment: acme-usage-q1-q2.csv (CSV, 120KB)

-Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platform, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acme.com>
Date: 2026-04-22 10:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — thanks for the call

Thanks Liam — great to meet you and thanks for the clear summary. Confirming everything below and adding a couple notes from our side: 

- We can target p95 <= 300ms for the recommendation engine by moving to a Dedicated pool and tuning batching/KV cache. Vivek will validate with the workload profile.
- Pricing: I ran a quick back-of-envelope based on the usage file — we'll share a formal estimate (breakdown of reserved vs burst capacity) in the next 48 hours.
- Privacy: For PII-sensitive flows we recommend Private (VPC) deployment or a Dedicated pool with strict network isolation + KMS integration.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Vivek (SE) to share instance recommendations + expected p95 by 2026-04-24.
- Marissa (me) to share Dedicated pricing estimate + MOP draft by 2026-04-24.
- Acme procurement to provide required SOW terms / redlines by 2026-04-29.
- Quick technical follow-up call to review migration checklist — proposed 2026-04-26 at 10am PT.

Attachment: acme-usage-q1-q2.csv (included from your export)

I'll also include Rachel from CS to ensure onboarding & success planning. If that timeline looks off, tell me which dates work better.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-22 11:03 PDT
Subject: RE: Renewal & Expansion — latency/instance recommendations

On Thu, Apr 22, 2026 at 10:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Liam — great to meet you and thanks for the clear summary.

Thanks all. I took a quick pass on the usage export — a few technical notes:

- Workload profile: 200 RPS peak with 1.2M tokens/day aligns well with a 4-GPU Dedicated pool (A800 class) with 2x reserved nodes + 1x burst. That config should get p95 latencies ~180–250ms assuming continuous KV cache warm.
- Cost optimization: quantized model variant (8-bit) for the rec engine gives ~2–2.5x throughput improvement with minimal quality drop on ranking tasks. We'll include a quality-check plan.
- Migration steps (high level): prefix cache warm, traffic shadowing for 1 week, canary with 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

I'll attach a pricing/tiers PDF and a short MOP draft for Marissa to include in the proposal.

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (PDF, 450KB)

Happy to jump on the 4/26 call for technical walkthrough.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-04-22 16:28 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — procurement / SOW

Marissa / Liam — thanks. From procurement's perspective we need: 

1) A draft SOW (scope, timelines, deliverables, acceptance criteria)
2) Standard MSA with Redwood's data handling appendix and SOC2 evidence references
3) Estimated monthly committed spend and cancellation terms so we can run through budget approval

Can you confirm when we can expect those docs? Also please send any standard redlines you typically accept.

Procurement email for record: procurement@acme.com

Thanks,
Priya Gupta
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-04-23 11:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — SOW, pricing, and next steps

Priya — thanks for the ask. Confirming delivery timeline and attachments below: 

- SOW / MOP draft: attached (20260422-acme-mop.pdf). Includes scope for migrating recommendation engine to Dedicated pool, acceptance criteria, and rollout checklist.
- Pricing: Vivek's pricing tiers are included in the attached PDF (redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf). I'll also open a HubSpot deal with the committed spend line items. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-2024-ACME-013
- MSA / SOC2: We'll surface the data handling appendix and SOC2 attestation in a separate email to procurement/legal (should have those to you by 2026-04-24).

Proposed timeline:
- 2026-04-24: Redwood to send final pricing + SOC2 attestation.
- 2026-04-26: Technical walkthrough (10am PT).
- 2026-04-29: Acme to provide SOW redlines / procurement feedback.
- Target go-live for Dedicated pilot: 2026-05-17 (2-week shadowing & canary window).

Attachment: 20260422-acme-mop.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
Related DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ACME-Statement-of-Work-2026

If that timeline works, I'll prepare the DocuSign SOW and the HubSpot proposal and circulate for signatures. 

Best,
